summary: The aggregate counts corroborate frequent literal I carrying, III loading and I Detransitive pregnancy; they do not require additional occurrence decisions. Existing active and Detransitive numbering is not parallel and is retained.

III loading alternates between a cargo object with an ʕal-marked carrier and a pack-animal/equipment object with cargo expressed separately. Hors 2/31 additionally has a beneficiary suffix. Human load-bearers occur in MAC NE Famine/68. This is valency variation within III.1.

I Detransitive pregnancy includes becoming pregnant and the resulting state, with animal as well as human subjects. PrS 1/2 has m- identifying the father; it is not an expressed loading agent. Animal pregnancy is already covered by trächtig in the inherited gloss.

The forms ṭʕino and ṭʕine must not be filed by English tense wording alone. PrS 60/10 ṭʕino is retained with the finite pregnancy paradigm, whereas plural ṭʕine predicates pregnancy states. The productive agent noun ṭaʕono is not evidence for a Part act. box.

Existing ġamo and ruḥo idioms explain the worry and setting-out tokens; no additional numbered senses are needed. Their new contextual attestations are recorded in decisions without duplicating the idiom list.

51/9 and 51/24 present a carrying riddle; 51/10 explicitly reflects a literal interpretation. The supplied verses do not themselves give the alleged explanation at 51/26, so a lexical storytelling sense is withheld.

Existing III Detransitive Part. Pass. examples already attest loaded mules/rafts and EL 36 = Hors 1/36. No new label is imposed on this unnumbered section. PrS 10/69 and 31/9 support the same resultant loaded state.

Round 2: Jan Beṯ-Şawoce. All English quotations below are the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation. Meanings were checked against Turoyo; uncertain readings are retained as questions.

Runde 1 füllt I Preterit 1, Infectum 1, Infectum 2, Infectum-wa 1, Imperativ 1 sowie III-Ladezellen bereits auf fünf oder vier bis fünf Belege. Die Leserangaben über dünne Zellen sind nicht der Stand nach Runde 1.
